max_tire.note: A 2014 G 550 owner on Expedition Portal ran KO2s in this size with no rubbing at full flex; 285/65R18 can rub slightly at full left lock. Later trucks' calipers may not clear every 18-inch wheel. Re-code the tire size
Eurowise's recommended maximum; with its King shock option Eurowise says 2013–2018 G 550s need only minor wheel-well trimming

Eurowise's recommendation for its 100 mm kit (listed for 2009–2015 G 550). Above 4 in, extended brake lines are required; expect the speedometer to read 5–8 mph off until re-coded and DISTRONIC to be affected

items.title: Fuel line quick connectors
items.summary: Underbody fuel-line quick connectors may not be fully seated; dealers check them and fit a securing clamp. 352 trucks

items.title: Front turn signals behind grille covers (FMVSS 108)
items.summary: Grille covers can reduce turn-signal output over time; dealers fit improved turn-signal units

items.title: Passenger airbag molding strip
items.summary: On trucks built Sept 2010–Apr 2011, molding-strip parts can come loose when the passenger airbag deploys

items.title: Steering coupling
items.summary: Insufficiently tightened steering coupling can wear; dealers replace it. 10,832 G 550, G 63 and G 65s

items.title: Inner door-handle release cable
items.summary: The cable that unlatches the door from inside may break if the door is hard to open, e.g. after a crash

items.title: ESP with DISTRONIC PLUS
items.summary: An ESP malfunction with DISTRONIC PLUS engaged may stop the engine reducing power; 8,043 trucks

items.title: Brake booster vacuum hose
items.summary: Vacuum hose for the brake booster may collapse, increasing pedal effort; includes the G 550 4×4²

items.title: Emergency-call date/time software
items.summary: eCall software fault can send an inaccurate location

timeline.change: US G 500 starts switching from the 722.6 five-speed to the 722.9 seven-speed; HID headlamps, reversing camera and TPMS arrive
G 550 replaces the G 500 in the US with the 5.5-litre M273 V8 (382 hp) and seven-speed automatic
Biggest interior update in years: ML-Class-derived dashboard with COMAND moved up, LED daytime lamps, new mirrors, DISTRONIC and blind-spot assist (2012 update, MY2013 in the US)
4.0-litre M176 twin-turbo V8 (416 hp, 450 lb-ft) replaces the M273; 7G-TRONIC PLUS; $119,900 base
Final model year of the original W463; the redesigned G arrives for MY2019

identify.intro: Many G 550s wear AMG bumpers, badges and wheels, and the M273 and M176 trucks look much the same. The VIN separates them.

items.head: VIN characters 4–8
items.body: Bring a Trailer examples decoded with NHTSA's vPIC tool: 2010–2014 G 550 (5.5 V8) = WDCYC3HF…, 2016 G 550 (4.0 twin-turbo) = WDCYC3KF…, 2018 G 550 = WDCYC3KH…. A 2015 G 63 AMG reads WDCYC7DF…, so a 'G 63' with a YC3 VIN is a dressed-up G 550.

items.head: 4×4² versus regular G 550
items.body: The 2017–2018 G 550 4×4² decodes as WDCYC5FF… / WDCYC5FH…, not YC3. A portal-axle truck without a YC5F VIN is an aftermarket conversion.

items.head: Model year (10th character)
items.body: The 10th character gives the model year (A = 2010, C = 2012, E = 2014, G = 2016, J = 2018). 2009–2015 trucks have the M273 5.5; 2016–2018 have the M176 twin-turbo.

items.head: Engine bay
items.body: The M273 is a naturally aspirated V8; the M176 has twin turbos inside the vee. A quick look settles which engine it is.

capability.note: MBUSA 2017 press kit; the 2018 spec sheet lists 8.1 in at maximum load

values.intro: Prices depend mostly on mileage and condition. Model year and engine matter less, and 2016–2018 twin-turbo trucks don't consistently beat good 2013–2015 trucks.
values.note: Based on 70 Bring a Trailer sales of 2009–2018 G 550s (not 4×4²) from January 2025 to October 2026, median about $63,000. The lowest was a 2010 at $26,000 and the highest a 49k-mile 2014 at $96,550.
